subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & data retention requirements (ZenWell)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwell.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@zenwell.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & data retention requirements (ZenWell)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery so the security and compliance thread is crystal clear.

Key pain points you shared:
- Audit visibility: Need detailed, queryable audit logs for admin actions and dataset access (not just aggregated metrics).
- Retention windows: Regulatory requirement around long-term retention for certain patient-related logs; you indicated up to 7 years for PII-related audit records, shorter for other telemetry.
- Evidence and assurances: Need SOC 2 Type II report, recent pen-test summary, and confirmation that we can provide tamper-evident audit logs and exportable VPC flow logs.
- Contract controls: DPA language and retention addendum required for procurement.

What we (Redwood) can share / support:
- SOC 2 Type II summary and scope (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). We can share the full report under NDA.
- Pen-test artifacts: high-level summary + evidence bundle (attached: pen-test-evidence.zip).
- Audit log model: we can provide the schema and examples for event-level logs; support exporting to your SIEM or S3 for long-term retention.
- DPA baseline: attached a draft DPA you can review (dpa_draft_redwood.pdf).

Agreed next steps:
1) Alex to confirm required retention windows by log type (e.g., admin events = 7y, access logs = 3y) — by end of day 4/19.
2) Redwood (Rishi + Neha) to provide SOC 2 summary, pen-test bundle, audit-log schema, and DPA draft (linked/attached) — by EOD 4/19.
3) Technical follow-up call to scope export/retention pipeline and any encryption/KMS requirements — propose 4/25 10:00 AM PT.
4) Procurement: ZenWell to indicate if a signed NDA is needed before we share full SOC2 report — please advise.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF), pen-test-evidence.zip (archive), dpa_draft_redwood.pdf (PDF)

If I missed anything, flag it here — otherwise we’ll proceed with the items above.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwell.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@zenwell.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & data retention requirements (ZenWell)

Thanks, Neha — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention windows: For regulated patient PII and audit trails tied to billing/claims we need 7 years. For general access logs (non-PII) we can keep 1–3 years depending on storage cost. I’ll work with Legal to confirm exact buckets but 7y for the set mentioned is non-negotiable.

- Evidence: We can sign an NDA; please route the SOC 2 full report under a one-way NDA (I’ve attached our standard security checklist for reference).

- Pen test: We need evidence of remediation timelines for any high/critical findings included in the pen-test bundle.

- KMS: We intend to keep keys in our KMS (customer-managed) if possible; can you confirm Redwood supports external KMS/HSM integrations for Private deployments?

I’ve attached: zenwell-security-checklist.xlsx (internal) — this is a living doc and will surface any additional asks. 

On the meeting: 4/25 10 AM PT works for Alex and Priya.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@zenwell.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & data retention requirements (ZenWell)

Alex / Neha — quick note from engineering/solutions:

- KMS: For Redwood Private we fully support customer-managed KMS via standard KMS/HSM integrations (bring-your-own-KMS). For Hosted, we offer dedicated customer key support via partner KMS (we can detail the flow).
- Audit logs: We can provide event-level logs with tamper-evident hashing and export connectors (S3, BigQuery, your SIEM). We’ll include schema + sample exports in the bundle.
- Retention: Configurable per-log-type retention policies; long-term storage is supported via lifecycle rules to your supplied S3 or via our archival store — we’ll include options and estimated storage costs.
- Pen-test evidence: We can include remediation timelines and CVE references for any moderate/high items; full vuln reports shared under NDA.

I’ll assemble the technical artifacts Neha attached and add an architecture note for the export pipeline before EOD 4/19.

Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
